candidates.description: This feature vector represents quantifiers and words denoting indefinite quantities across multiple languages.
These tokens represent additive or concessive adverbial conjunctions and connectors across multiple European languages.
This vector represents the concept of utilization, action, or application across multiple languages.
German auxiliary, modal, and common finite verbs expressing tense, mood, and state.
This vector activates on common German prepositions and indefinite articles.
Inflected third-person singular and plural verbs in various Romance and Germanic languages.
This vector represents logical transition, consequence, and causal connectors across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents temporal adverbs and modifiers expressing time, repetition, or continuity across multiple languages.
Thai tone marks and vowel-consonant clusters used in the Thai script.
This feature vector activates on tokens containing the phonetic sounds "ok" or "ak" across various scripts and capitalization styles.
